description: The project's reports (saved views of a table: filters, grouping, totals). Without entity_id: EVERY report of every table, each with its id and the table it belongs to — use this when the person names a report and not its table; never guess the table from the report's name. With entity_id: that one table's reports.

entity_id.description: A table's id. Leave it out to list the reports of the whole project.

name: get_reports
